critical_code_review_comments: AdaptiveModePanel.cycleMode auto-injects max_tp_pips_per_symbol={XAUUSD:100,BTCUSD:100} when cycling INTO win_rate but never strips it when cycling back to expected_value/trend_follow. Side effect: cycling through win_rate leaks per-symbol caps onto accounts that did not explicitly opt in. Consider clearing the auto-injected caps when leaving win_rate, or only persist the cap when the user explicitly confirms.

/bot/adaptive-status returns full shape even on the default cfg (no account_id) — good fallback. The auto_preset.reason field is populated with a human-readable string which is useful for the would→ badge UX.

BotConfigUpdate field coercion is defensive — invalid profit_taking_mode silently coerced to expected_value with 200 instead of 422. This is the documented contract (and the iter-74 unit tests assert it), but consider surfacing a soft warning in the response so the frontend can show a toast if user typoed.

AdaptiveModePanel polls every 30s via setInterval inside useEffect — fine for a single-panel use case, but if user opens 5+ dashboards (multi-tab), every tab independently polls. Consider visibilitychange gate to pause polling on hidden tabs.
Panel correctly filters out crypto accounts (a.kind!=null) and disconnected accounts — the 3 connected MT5 accounts render exactly as expected. No card leak for kraken_spot or binance bridges.
